summary: BARKEDALEN AS (org. no. 921 792 921) is a private limited company (AS) based in Fredrikstad, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2018-12-20. The register states no bankruptcy, liquidation or compulsory dissolution. Its main activity is NACE 43.120 (Grunnarbeid); it has 9 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) operating revenue was NOK 4 518 569 and net income was NOK 179 862. CEO: Hilde Cecilie Larsen; board chair: Bård Christian Larsen. Most recent dated item found (2026-04-15): "Godkjente årsregnskap" (category: Approved annual accounts) – Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer. 12 dated news/announcement items are listed with source links.

verification.method: Every fact comes from a record fetched by the exact organisation number. Secondary sources (GLEIF, Wikidata) are only accepted when their record names this number AND the legal name or LEI agrees; financial values are copied as filed and never estimated.

checks.check: organisation number checksum (mod 11)
registry record organisation number equals query

gaps.reason: Legal form ENK is normally not required to file annual accounts in Norway, so none were looked up.
No website is registered in Enhetsregisteret, and no candidate could be proven to belong to this company (checked 3 name-matching domain(s); none proven to belong to this company).
GLEIF has no LEI record registered under this organisation number.
No dated announcement or company-site news post that provably refers to this company was found in the sources checked.
Wikidata was not queried (only listed or large companies, or LEI holders, are looked up there).
